component.name: Submarine
component.summary: SSH, SFTP, FTP and remote desktop client

description.p: Submarine keeps your servers in one window. Each server opens as a tab with its terminal, files, tunnels and tools around the same session, and your profile stays encrypted on your device.

ul.li: SSH terminals with split views, a wall of terminals across servers, and input broadcast to several sessions
SFTP file browser, folder transfers, and folder mirrors that follow changes
Local, remote and SOCKS tunnels, jump hosts and SSH agent logins
Built-in RDP and VNC clients, and Telnet
Docker containers, logs and shells, live server monitoring, and a per-server command library
Optional cloud sync, encrypted on your device before it is sent

description.p: This version runs in a sandbox, so it can't start programs installed on your system. A ProxyCommand runs inside the sandbox, and RDP servers use the built-in client, not an RDP app such as Remmina.

screenshot.caption: A terminal with the SFTP file browser beside it
